name: Thousand Cut Strike (Combat)
body:
You can make your weapons a whirling wall of steel. The attacks may not land as hard but there are a lot of them.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, base attack bonus +1.

Benefit(s): You can choose to take a -2 penalty on all melee damage rolls to gain a +1 attack bonus on melee attacks. When your base attack bonuses reaches +4, and every 4 points thereafter, the damage penalty increases by -2 and the attack bonus increases by +1. This bonus does not extend to combat maneuver checks and the normal minimum damage rules apply. The benefits and penalties of this ability are not affected by the size of the weapon. The feat may not be enacted in a round in which another feat or ability grants an additional attack in the round, like a monk’s flurry of blows. However, additional attacks like those granted from the haste spell still allow the usage of this feat. Additionally, the feat cannot be used to deliver precision damage. This feat cannot be used in conjunction with the Power Attack or Piranha Strike feats.
